newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 580 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 580 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 580 contracts compared with 1,154 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 23 wheat, 203 corn, 291 soybean, five soymeal, and 58 soyoil contracts traded..
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/2 cents higher to 1/4 cent lower, corn was 1/2 to one cent higher and soybeans were one to 6-1/4 cents higher.
